messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: HTML_UI
parts:
You can't deploy them directly in Apache. However, you can set up Shiny to run on a different port and then have Apache proxy it, something like this:

ProxyPass /my_app/ http://localhost:3838/my_app/
ProxyPassReverse /my_app/ http://localhost:3838/my_app/
RedirectMatch permanent ^/my_app$ /my_app/
